title: NDT Report Validation: Knoxville–Oak Ridge, TN | Data Review
description: Independent review of NDT reports and digital inspection data from Oak Ridge DOE sites, new reactor and fuel plant builds and TVA plants, done remotely.
h1: Independent NDT report review for Oak Ridge, Knoxville and the TVA plants of East Tennessee
eyebrow: Report validation: Knoxville and Oak Ridge, Tennessee
intro: The Knoxville–Oak Ridge corridor holds an unusual range of nuclear work in one valley. Department of Energy sites run under their own quality rules, advanced reactor and fuel plants are being built under NRC permits and licences, and the Tennessee Valley Authority operates nuclear and fossil plants while it builds new gas generation. Fabricators and machine shops across East Tennessee supply all of them. We give the owners, contractors and suppliers behind those records an independent review of NDT reports and the digital inspection data behind them, tested against the procedure, the code and the quality program that governed the work, carried out remotely on the files you send.

highlights.p: A DOE contractor's quality program, an NRC licensee's quality program and a utility's fossil plant inspection program each judge an NDT record differently. The opinion starts by identifying which one applies.

Reactor and fuel plant construction often brings acceptance criteria written into project specifications rather than lifted straight from a code. The reviewer checks the record against what the specification actually required.

highlights.h: A reader with nothing at stake
highlights.p: Atlantis never reviews examinations it performed and has no interest in whether a report passes. The opinion is something a quality organisation can weigh on its merits.

sections.h: Who produces inspection records in the corridor
p: The Department of Energy's presence sets the tone. Consolidated Nuclear Security, LLC is the management and operating contractor for the Y-12 National Security Complex, and Oak Ridge National Laboratory is managed by UT-Battelle for DOE. Around them, a new generation of commercial nuclear projects is under way. The NRC has issued construction permits for Kairos Power's Hermes test reactors at the East Tennessee Technology Park in Oak Ridge; construction of the first began in 2024, and Kairos broke ground on Hermes 2 in April 2026, now planned to produce 50 megawatts of electricity and expected to operate by 2030. TRISO-X received its NRC special nuclear material licence in February 2026 for TX-1, a fuel fabrication facility under construction on its 110-acre campus in Oak Ridge, with fabrication expected to begin in early 2028. On September 29, 2026 the NRC issued TVA a construction permit for a GE Vernova Hitachi BWRX-300 at its Clinch River site in Oak Ridge.

TVA's operating fleet adds two more streams. Watts Bar, the authority's two-unit pressurized water reactor plant at Spring City about 60 miles southwest of Knoxville, sits under NRC Region II, and its Unit 2 licence runs to 2055. At Kingston, in Roane County, TVA is building a natural gas combined cycle plant, sixteen dual-fuel aeroderivative combustion turbines and a 100-megawatt battery system to replace the coal units, and a supplemental environmental review issued in February 2026 proposes keeping the nine coal units running alongside the new generation.

The facilities named here describe the industrial landscape that generates records in the region. Naming them does not mean Atlantis has reviewed their records, worked for their owners or holds any approval from them.

sections.h: Three oversight regimes, three ways a record is judged
p: The same ultrasonic weld report can be read three different ways in East Tennessee depending on where the weld ends up. Before testing a record, the reviewer establishes which regime it belongs to and who in that regime will decide what the opinion is worth.

sections.h: DOE facilities: the contractor's quality program decides
p: At DOE nuclear facilities the controlling rule is 10 CFR 830, not the NRC's Part 50. Under 10 CFR 830.121, contractors whose items or services affect or may affect nuclear safety at a DOE nuclear facility must work under the quality criteria in 830.122, the responsible contractor submits a quality assurance program to DOE for approval, and that program must describe how its subcontractors and suppliers satisfy the criteria. An NDT record produced for one of those facilities is therefore judged against the contractor's approved program as well as against the code and procedure.

We do not claim a place in any DOE contractor's supplier program. An independent technical opinion can still be useful inside one: a second reading of a subcontractor's examination records before acceptance, a check on an interpretation the contractor's own engineers question, or technical input when a dispute turns on what an examination showed. The contractor's QA organisation decides whether the opinion enters its records and what weight it carries.

Records from DOE sites often need release review before they leave the site. The owner decides what can be sent, and the review is carried out on what has been released; nothing in the process requires access to anything the owner has not cleared.

sections.h: Reactor and fuel plant construction: vendor records for unfamiliar equipment
p: Construction of test reactors, a fuel fabrication plant and a small modular reactor brings a volume of fabrication and installation records that the region has not seen in decades. Some of the equipment is unfamiliar: components for molten salt service, high-temperature materials, and process equipment for fuel manufacture. Acceptance criteria are frequently set by project specifications and invoked code cases rather than by a single code table, which makes the question of which requirement applied the first thing to settle.

Atlantis is not on any licensee's or permit holder's 10 CFR 50 Appendix B or NQA-1 approved supplier list. Nuclear work is offered as an independent technical opinion that the licensee's QA organisation decides how to use, for example oversight of a vendor's records before shipment, a second reader on non-safety-related scope, or input to a commercial dispute between an owner and a supplier.

For vendor data on construction projects the reviewer checks that each examination cites the specification revision and code edition in force when the purchase order was placed, that examiners held the certification the order required on the date of work, that ultrasonic techniques on thick or coarse-grained sections were qualified for that material, that penetrant examinations on austenitic and nickel alloy welds recorded the system, dwell and surface temperature, and that radiographic or DR images reach the image quality the procedure demands. Every indication must have a disposition traceable to the acceptance standard the specification named.

sections.h: TVA's fleet: Watts Bar outages and the Kingston transition
p: Outages at a pressurized water reactor generate ultrasonic examinations of welds and components, liquid penetrant and visual records, and eddy current data from steam generator and heat exchanger tubes, much of it from contractors working on short schedules. Watts Bar falls under NRC Region II, and the same framing applies as for any licensee: an independent opinion the plant's QA organisation chooses how to use. Eddy current is not among our Level III's five certified methods, so tube data is reviewed by a reviewer the proposal names with the certification the contract requires.

Kingston produces two kinds of record at once. The new combined cycle plant, the aeroderivative turbines and their balance of plant arrive with manufacturer's data books written to ASME Section I, Section VIII and B31.1, which the reviewer reads joint by joint against drawings and purchase orders. The coal units, which the February 2026 review proposes to keep running, still depend on boiler tube thickness surveys and header and attachment weld examinations to set each outage's scope. Whether those surveys are repeatable from one outage to the next decides how far the owner's engineer can trust the trend.

sections.h: East Tennessee shops and the records they ship
p: Fabricators and machine shops in the Knoxville area build piping, vessels, skids and machined components for DOE contractors, the new nuclear projects and power plants. A shop shipping into a nuclear project lives with stricter documentation than one shipping into a fossil plant, and the same shop may do both in a single month. A review before the data book leaves the shop catches problems while the welder, the examiner and the heat records are still within reach. The review looks for:
list: A weld map that agrees with the drawings and accounts for every joint the specification requires to be examined
Examination reports that cite the procedure revision the purchase order named, not the shop's latest revision
Examiner certifications covering the method, technique and level signed for, valid on each examination date, under the shop's written practice
Calibration blocks and reference standards identified and traceable, with system checks recorded before and after the work
Repair welds examined again after repair, and after the final heat treatment where the specification requires it
Material certificates and positive material identification results tied to heat numbers and individual welds

sections.h: Tennessee rules behind an inspection record
p: Tennessee is an NRC Agreement State, and its Division of Radiological Health within the Department of Environment and Conservation administers the radioactive materials program that licenses industrial radiography contractors in the state. The NRC's oversight is split: Region II in Atlanta covers operating reactors and fuel facilities, while Region I in King of Prussia handles the agency's materials work for Tennessee. Atlantis does not perform industrial radiography in Tennessee or elsewhere in the United States; radiographs and CR or DR images from your licensed contractor are reviewed as documents.

Boilers and pressure vessels fall to the Boiler Unit in the Workplace Regulations and Compliance Division of the Department of Labor and Workforce Development, which oversees inspections and licenses repair and erection companies. Certificate inspections are made by deputy or special inspectors, and the state's own and insurance inspectors are both nationally commissioned and authorised by the state. Acceptance of a boiler or vessel stays with that inspector, and Atlantis does not act as authorized inspector or inspector of record.

Workplace safety for private employers runs through Tennessee OSHA, a state plan that has adopted federal OSHA standards with a handful of state-specific exceptions, so process safety management applies to covered chemical processes. TVA facilities are excluded from the state plan's coverage and remain with federal OSHA.

sections.h: Digital inspection data in a corridor of quality programs
p: Quality programs at DOE sites and NRC-licensed projects place heavy weight on records, and most of those records are now digital: encoded phased array and TOFD files from vendor shops, DR images exchanged as DICONDE or vendor formats, thickness data in plant inspection databases, and examination packages issued through digital reporting platforms with electronic signatures and controlled templates. A quality organisation that accepts a PDF without the data behind it is accepting a summary, not the evidence.

A digital inspection review follows each result back to its source. We confirm that raw files exist and match the report, that phased array setups and focal laws are the ones the procedure qualified, that re-gating reproduces the reported indication sizes, that any processing of a digital radiograph was recorded and allowed, and that each electronic signature belongs to someone certified for that method and level on the date shown, using the template revision in force. Where a vendor's digital reporting system fills fields automatically, the review checks that values were not carried forward from a different job.

sections.h: How a review runs from East Tennessee
p: Atlantis keeps nobody in Knoxville or Oak Ridge. The review is done remotely from Houston and Hyderabad on the records you release to us through secure transfer, so no badge, escort or site access is involved.

You describe the report, the method, the code or specification, the quality program it sits under and the decision it supports, using the form or info@atlantisndt.com. We reply within one business day with the review scope, the named reviewer and a quote. For the five methods that make up most fabrication records, UT, RT, MT, PT and VT, the lead reviewer is an ASNT NDT Level III certified in each of them; the review team around that Level III has members who come from nuclear, maritime, oil and gas and petrochemical work.

Each report receives one of three verdicts: sound, deficient in documentation only, or deficient in disposition, with each finding tied to a clause, specification paragraph or procedure step. Fitness-for-service and remaining-life calculations stay with the owner's engineer, and certification of personnel stays with their employer under its written practice.

faqs.q: Can you review records for work at a DOE facility in Oak Ridge?
faqs.a: We can give an independent technical opinion on records the owner has released for review. Atlantis claims no place in any DOE contractor's supplier program, so the contractor's QA organisation decides how the opinion is used under its own 10 CFR 830 quality program.

faqs.q: We are a vendor shipping components to a new reactor or fuel plant project. Can you check our data book first?
faqs.a: Yes. We read it against the purchase order, the specification revision and the code edition and code cases it invokes, and list each gap with the requirement it fails. Atlantis does not hold a place on any licensee's Appendix B or NQA-1 approved supplier list, so the review is a pre-shipment check for you, not a substitute for the licensee's own acceptance.

faqs.q: Do records have to leave our site for the review?
faqs.a: Only what you release. The review is remote and works from the documents and data files you choose to send; the owner decides what can leave the site, and nothing requires access to anything not cleared.

faqs.q: Can you review eddy current tube data from a Watts Bar outage?
faqs.a: Tube data is reviewed by a reviewer the proposal names who holds the eddy current certification the contract requires, because our Level III is certified in UT, RT, MT, PT and VT and not in eddy current. Any opinion on nuclear plant records is offered as independent input the station's QA organisation decides how to use.

faqs.q: Do you take radiographs in Tennessee?
faqs.a: No. Atlantis does not carry out industrial radiography anywhere in the United States. Film, CR and DR images from your licensed contractor are reviewed for image quality, coverage and interpretation against the acceptance standard.

faqs.q: Our acceptance criteria come from a project specification rather than a code table. Can the review handle that?
faqs.a: Yes, and it is common on new nuclear work. The reviewer establishes which specification revision, code edition and code cases governed the examination, then tests each disposition against those requirements rather than against a default code table.

faqs.q: Can a review support a Tennessee boiler repair before the inspector's visit?
faqs.a: It can. We review the repair NDE against the construction code and the documentation the inspector will expect. Acceptance stays with the deputy or special inspector commissioned by the state.

faqs.q: How do we get a review started from Knoxville or Oak Ridge?
faqs.a: Send the report or a sample, the procedure and specification, the quality program it falls under and the decision it supports. You will have a reply within one business day with the scope, the reviewer's name and a quote.
